text:
pagerduty-bot: :rotating_light: P1 Alert: Elevated 5xx/timeouts for tenant "AuroraWallet" on dedicated-cluster-eu-west-1. 5xx jumped to ~21% over 5m, median p95 latency +350ms. Alert fired at 2026-03-14T05:16:07Z
marta-oncall: Acknowledging. I'm on the page. Paging SRE/ENG. @oliver-sre @hema-eng @kai-support please join.
incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-0314-03 created. Runbook: dedicated-tenant-5xx. Severity: P1.
oliver-sre: I'm seeing a pattern: gateway 502 + a subset of workers with high iowait and heavy swap activity. Looks tenant-scoped to AuroraWallet. Possible noisy neighbor or a bad client retry loop.
hema-eng: Pulling logs and model metrics. Can someone paste recent gateway lines?
oliver-sre: Gateway logs:
```
2026-03-14T05:16:30Z gateway-gw2: req_id=zzx111 tenant=AuroraWallet upstream=worker-9 status=502 err="upstream reset by peer"
2026-03-14T05:16:31Z worker-9[AuroraWallet]: infer: stalled on kv_cache write; stall_reason=kv_lock_timeout
2026-03-14T05:16:32Z gateway-gw1: req_id=zzx112 tenant=AuroraWallet status=504 err="deadline exceeded"
```
hema-eng: I also see a recent model rollout yesterday (model: conversational-2.1-quant) that increased memory pressure on the pool. Could be correlated.
kai-support: Customer ops pinged: "We started seeing failed txs and auth timeouts around 05:05 UTC; intermittent successes." They've already turned on client-side throttling but still bleeding errors.
marta-oncall: Priorities: 1) Put tenant-level emergency throttle 2) Route heavy requests to model:conversational-2.1-light or to a different region temporarily 3) Isolate noisy workers 4) Consider rollback of model rollout if correlated. Who can apply which?
oliver-sre: I can cordon/evict the most impacted node (worker-9) and apply a tenant throttle via control-plane.
hema-eng: I'll prepare a regional shift rule to redirect AuroraWallet traffic to eu-north-1 (lighter load) as a temporary failover, and I'll inspect the model rollout diffs for yesterday.
deploy-bot: Starting policy apply job job=policy-312 for dedicated-cluster-eu-west-1

# Apply emergency throttle
curl -s -X POST "https://control.redwood.internal/api/v1/tenants/aurorawallet/policy" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${OP_TOKEN}" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"max_concurrency":5,"qps_limit":80,"fallback_model":"conversational-2.1-light","reason":"emergency throttle due to elevated 5xx"}'

hema-eng: Policy API returned 200. Rolling to gateways.
marta-oncall: Also request a short-lived regional failover: shift 30% of their traffic to eu-north-1 and 70% remain in eu-west-1 to avoid data plane surprises. Hema please start incremental DNAT route shift.
hema-eng: Triggering split-route via control plane: set-region-weight aurorawallet eu-west-1=70 eu-north-1=30 (control plane accepted).

# Evict noisy worker
oliver-sre: Evicting worker-9 from serving AuroraWallet now:
```
rbctl set-affinity --cluster eu-west-1 --node worker-9 --tenant AuroraWallet deny
rbctl drain --node worker-9 --grace 20s
```
oliver-sre: Drain completed and node cordoned. Observed drop of 10k concurrent inflight requests on that node.

deploy-bot: Policy rollout to gateways completed. job=policy-312 status=success

oliver-sre: After throttle + eviction + split-route, error rate dropped from 21% -> 9% in the first 5m window. Latency p95 reduced by ~180ms. Still above target.
hema-eng: Spinning up +4 additional workers in eu-west-1 to handle warm-up of kv_cache; also starting cache-warm job to pre-populate hot keys for AuroraWallet.

# Observability snapshot (metrics query)
rbctl cluster-metrics --cluster eu-west-1 --tenant AuroraWallet --last 10m
# returns: 5xx=8.9% cpu_util=78% swap=12% kv_cache_hit=62%

kai-support: Customer update sent: "We've applied rate limiting and temporary routing; we're seeing improving success rates and will update every 10m." They asked if you can avoid full model rollback if possible.
marta-oncall: Given correlation with the recent rollout, let's not rollback yet — try to stabilize with throttles and regional shift. If error rates don't fall below 5% in 20m, prepare to rollback conversational-2.1-quant for AuroraWallet only. Hema, can you scope a canary rollback?
hema-eng: Yes. I can revert AuroraWallet's routing to conversational-2.0-stable as a targeted override. Preparing the revert plan now.

# 12 minutes later
oliver-sre: New workers online, KV warm-ups running. Error rate trending 5xx=4.8% at 05:34 UTC after +4 nodes and policy. No further kv_lock timeouts observed.
marta-oncall: Good. Maintain monitoring for 25m. If stable, we'll de-escalate to P2 and handoff.

kai-support: Customer reported transactions success rate up to ~95% since 05:30 UTC. They requested a post-incident summary once we de-escalate.
hema-eng: Note: I found a subtle bug in the model runner's cache eviction interaction with quantized weights that increased disk IOPS during peak loads. I will open a ticket: ENG-QUIRK-2026-042 to fix safe-eviction ordering. This likely exacerbated the swap pressure under heavy kv cache misses.

marta-oncall: Action items before close:
- (SRE) oliver-sre: make tenant-protection rule durable for AuroraWallet: default max_concurrency=25 with token-bucket burst controls and an alert for sustained qps>threshold.
- (Eng) hema-eng: patch the model-runner eviction ordering and add canary for conversational-2.1-quant; add a rollout guard for dedicated clusters.
- (Support) kai-support: schedule customer follow-up and include recommended client retry/backoff guidance and SDK knob suggestions.
- (Product) product-engage: consider adding per-tenant model deployment guards for high-memory variants on dedicated clusters.

incident-bot: Mitigations recorded: [tenant throttle, split-region routing, worker eviction worker-9, scale_up +4, kv_cache warmup]. Incident de-escalated to P2 at 05:58 UTC after sustained error rates <5% for 25m.
marta-oncall: I'll open the postmortem doc and assign authors. Handoff: @oliver-sre will take overnight watch starting 06:00 UTC. Confirm?
oliver-sre: Confirmed. I'll take watch and draft the postmortem with timeline graphs and policy diffs.
kai-support: I'll prepare the customer-facing summary and runbook items.
hema-eng: I'll include the rollout guard changes and the ENG-QUIRK-2026-042 ticket in the postmortem.
incident-bot: Postmortem issue PM-INC-2026-0314-03 created and assigned to oliver-sre, hema-eng, kai-support.
marta-oncall: Thanks team. If anything regresses, reopen this thread and tag me. :lock: 
-- end of thread --
